message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/test_libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"read_callback","line":314,"var":"buffer","code":"memcpy(buffer, data, *bytes);","note":"The unit-test callback copies attacker-controlled input bytes into the bitreader's staging buffer."},
{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_from_client_","line":137,"var":"target","code":"target = ((FLAC__byte*)(br->buffer+br->words)) + br->bytes;","note":"The bitreader computes a write target inside its internal buffer based on current word/byte state."},
{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_from_client_","line":160,"var":"br->buffer","code":"if(!br->read_callback(target, &bytes, br->client_data)) return false;","note":"The callback populates the internal buffer with the input bytes at the computed position."},
{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":419,"var":"br->buffer[br->consumed_words]","code":"*val = (FLAC__uint32)(word >> (FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD-bits));","note":"A subsequent raw read consumes bits directly from the buffered word."},
{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":408,"var":"br->consumed_words","code":"if(br->consumed_words < br->words) {","note":"The function assumes the current word index is valid whenever enough bits are available."},
{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":406,"var":"bits","code":"FLAC__ASSERT(bits <= 32);","note":"The vulnerable path is a bitreader read request that steers execution into the word-extraction logic."}
]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(path.read_text())
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && printf '\nPOC\n' && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
p.write_bytes(b'\xff'*64)
print(len(p.read_bytes()))
PY
